help.guideIntro: Short, task-by-task instructions for the everyday jobs.

backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.l1: More → Backup & restore → Create backup. The file is encrypted with a passphrase you choose.
backup.l2: Keep the file somewhere safe (cloud drive, email to yourself). Without the passphrase it cannot be opened – not even by us.
backup.l3: Restore on a new phone from the same screen. Your products, offers, print history and settings come back; a restore that is interrupted resumes safely.

languages.title: Languages and currency
languages.l1: Six languages: English, Arabic, Turkish, French, Spanish and German. Arabic flips the layout right-to-left.
languages.l2: The label language is separate from the app language: an English app can print Arabic labels, and the other way round. Set it in More → Label settings.
languages.l3: Changing the currency changes how prices are shown; it does not convert your figures.

support.title: Getting safe support
support.l1: More → About → Email support. The email opens with your app version and device already filled in.
support.l2: Describe the screen and what you were trying to do; add a screenshot if it shows no sensitive figures.
support.l3: Never send backup passphrases, bank details, store passwords or unredacted product lists. Support will only ever ask for redacted information.

firstLabels.title: Your first labels
firstLabels.l1: Choose the app language, your shop currency and the label language on Home → Set up. Each is set on its own.
firstLabels.l2: Print a Label test on the paper you will use (More → Print setup). Check the top, middle and bottom labels.
firstLabels.l3: Add products (Products → Add, Scan or Import) or make a one-off Quick label from Home.
firstLabels.l4: Open To print, choose the stationery and where to start on the sheet, preview the exact PDF and print.

products.title: Product name and label name
products.l1: The product name is kept exactly as you typed or imported it, however long.
products.l2: The label name is what prints. It has a counter (for example 38 / 40); leave it empty if the full name already fits.
products.l3: Every label type has fixed text sizes. Nothing shrinks to fit: if text is too wide, the app says so and suggests a shorter label name or a larger format.
products.l4: Changing a price puts the label in To print automatically. Saving without a change adds nothing.

scanning.title: Scanning barcodes
scanning.l1: Products → Scan opens a product from its barcode; an unknown code offers to add it.
scanning.l2: The camera is used only to read the code. Use the torch in dim aisles, or type the code instead.
scanning.l3: A barcode with a wrong check digit is refused, never corrected, so the printed barcode always matches the product.

importing.title: Importing products
importing.l1: Products → Import reads CSV and Excel (.xlsx) files, or a price-change file from another Till family app.
importing.l2: Match the columns, then confirm how prices are written (1,234.56 or 1.234,56). The app never guesses a value like 1,234.
importing.l3: The preview shows every row as New, Changed, Same, Conflict or Invalid. Nothing is saved until you tap Import, and then all rows are saved or none.
importing.l4: Full names and codes are kept as they are in your file; nothing is shortened.

printing.title: Printing and confirming
printing.l1: To print lists only labels whose printed content changed. Products and labels are counted separately.
printing.l2: For a part-used sheet, set the start label so the used ones are skipped. Never feed a used sticker sheet through the printer again.
printing.l3: Preview shows the exact PDF that prints. After you print and come back, the app asks whether the labels printed correctly.
printing.l4: Only “Yes, printed” clears labels from To print. Keep waiting leaves them; Share PDF never counts as printed.

calibration.title: Stationery and calibration
calibration.l1: More → Print setup lists the shelf tickets, sticker sheets and offer cards. Pro users can add their own sheet with its exact measurements.
calibration.l2: Print the calibration page at 100% / Actual size and measure the 100 mm line first. If it is not 100 mm, the printer is scaling.
calibration.l3: If every label is shifted by the same amount, enter the measurements and apply the offset (0.5 mm steps).
calibration.l4: If the shift grows down the sheet, it is scaling or paper feed; an offset cannot fix that. Check Actual size and the paper guides.

offers.title: Offers and reductions
offers.l1: Home → Offers creates was/now, % off, money off, multibuy and member-price offers (Pro). The product's normal price never changes.
offers.l2: Offer labels go to To print. Choose a shelf ticket, or an A6 (portrait or landscape), A5 or A4 card for a bigger price.
offers.l3: If a price is wider than a format allows at its fixed size, the app says the price needs a larger label format.
offers.l4: Reduced to clear prints was/now labels for short-dated stock; it is stored apart from the product.

help.faqIntro: Short answers to the questions shop owners ask most.

gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.a1: {{app}} works offline. Your products, prices and labels are stored on your device. Only the Pro purchase talks to Apple or Google and RevenueCat, and only files you choose to import, export, share, print or back up leave the app.

dataPrivacy.title: Data & privacy
dataPrivacy.q1: Does {{app}} send my figures to a server?
dataPrivacy.a1: No. Your products and prices are not sent to {{app}} servers; there is no account and no cloud. You are responsible for backup files, exports and anything you share outside the app.

permissions.title: Camera & files
permissions.q1: Why does the app ask for the camera or files?
permissions.a1: The camera is used only to read barcodes on the scan screen; no photo is taken or stored. Files are accessed only when you import a CSV, export a PDF or CSV, share, or create and restore a backup. The app asks the first time you use each feature.

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.q1: What happens if I lose my phone?
troubleshooting.a1: If you have no backup, the data on the phone is lost. Create a backup from More → Backup & restore, keep the file somewhere safe and remember its passphrase; restore it on the new phone from the same screen.
troubleshooting.q2: Does deleting the app delete my data?
troubleshooting.a2: Yes. Because everything is stored on the device, uninstalling removes your products, labels and settings unless you backed them up first. Backups and exports you saved elsewhere are not affected.

support.title: Contact support
support.a1: Email {{supportEmail}} – the button in More → About fills in your app and device details. Add the screen you were on, what you were trying to do and screenshots if they contain no sensitive figures.
support.q2: What can I safely send to support?
support.a2: Your device type, operating system version, app version, the screen name, a short description and screenshots with sensitive figures hidden. Never send backup passphrases, bank details, store account passwords or unredacted product lists.

printing.title: Printing
printing.q1: My labels print slightly off the lines. What do I do?
printing.a1: Use More → Printer calibration. Print the page at Actual size, measure it, and the app tells you whether a small offset fixes it or the printer is scaling.
printing.q2: Everything prints a little too small.
printing.a2: The print dialog is set to Fit to page. Choose 100% / Actual size (sometimes called “None” for scaling) and print again.
printing.q3: I shared the PDF. Why are the labels still waiting?
printing.a3: Sharing is not printing. Labels leave To print only when you print and then answer “Yes, printed”, so a price change is never lost.

labels.title: Labels
labels.q1: Why doesn't the app shrink a long name to fit?
labels.a1: Like a till system, every label of a type uses the same fixed sizes so your shelves look consistent. Write a shorter label name; your full product name is kept.
labels.q2: It says “This price needs a larger label format”.
labels.a2: The price, as printed with its currency, is wider than that label's fixed price area. Print it on a larger ticket or an offer card; the product and price are not changed.
labels.q3: A printed barcode will not scan.
labels.a3: Check the print is sharp and at Actual size, and that the blank space either side of the bars is not trimmed. Test with your shop scanner before printing many.

plans.title: Free and Pro
plans.a1: Free includes up to 200 products, price, unit-price and barcode labels, CSV, Excel and Till family imports, preview, calibration, unlimited printing, backup and all six languages. Pro is a one-time purchase that adds unlimited products, offers, reductions, offer cards, your own sheets and multiple profiles. Existing data is never locked.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how {{app}}, provided by {{publisher}}, handles your information.
privacy.p1: Your products, prices, label history and settings are stored only on your device. {{app}} has no account system and no server that holds your data.
privacy.p2: The app contains no analytics, advertising or crash-reporting libraries. Your products, prices and labels stay on your device and are not sent to TillLabel servers.
privacy.h3: Device features the app may use
privacy.l1: Camera – only to read barcodes when you open the scanner. No photo is stored.
privacy.l2: Files – when you import a CSV, or export, share or back up your data.
privacy.l3: Sharing – when you send a PDF or CSV to another app. What you share leaves the app and is no longer under its control.
privacy.l4: In-app purchase – handled by Apple or Google and the purchase service RevenueCat, which receives a purchase receipt and an anonymous app-install identifier. No name, email or business data is sent.
privacy.p3: You can edit or delete anything in the app at any time. Uninstalling the app deletes its data from the device, apart from backups and exports you made yourself.
privacy.p4: Backup files are encrypted with a passphrase you choose. We cannot open or recover them. Where you store them is up to you.
privacy.p5: {{app}} is intended for business users and is not directed at children. {{publisher}} does not knowingly collect personal data from children.
privacy.p6: For privacy questions or data requests, contact {{privacyEmail}}.
privacy.l5: App updates – new versions come only through the App Store or Google Play. The app does not download code updates itself.
privacy.p7: You are responsible for the files you export or share, for your backup files and their passphrases, and for your device-level backup settings. Files you export or share leave the app and are no longer under its control.
privacy.p8: Do not send your product lists, prices or backup files to support unless they are specifically requested and have been redacted. Never send backup passphrases, bank details or store account passwords.
privacy.p9: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be reflected in the app and the date above will be updated; the version in the app is the current one.

dataStorage.title: Data Storage & Backup Notice
dataStorage.p1: Your products, prices, label history and settings are stored locally on your device.
dataStorage.l1: Deleting the app deletes its locally stored data.
dataStorage.l2: Device loss, damage, reset or uninstall may cause data loss.
dataStorage.l3: Back up regularly from More → Backup & restore; keep the file somewhere safe.
dataStorage.l4: Backup and export files contain your products and prices and should be stored securely and shared only with people you trust.
dataStorage.l5: Backups are encrypted with the passphrase you choose. If you lose that passphrase, the backup cannot be restored – not by you and not by us.
dataStorage.n1: {{app}} cannot recover locally stored data if the device, the backup passphrase or a usable backup is lost.
dataStorage.p2: To report a security concern, contact {{securityEmail}}. Do not include backup passphrases, bank details or unredacted price files in the initial report.

labelSettings.offerStyleHint: Ink-saving prints only an outline — use it on yellow paper or labels. Standard labels are always white.
labelSettings.skuOnCardsHint: Off by default: shoppers do not need it
labelSettings.promoBarcodeHint: Only on formats with room for it (offer cards); tickets keep the price large
labelSettings.unitDecimalsHint: Some countries ask for more precise unit prices than selling prices. 0 = the currency's own decimals.
labelSettings.saveFailed: The setting could not be saved.

importer.title: Import products
importer.subtitle: CSV, Excel or TillCalc
importer.pickBody: A CSV or Excel (.xlsx) file with at least a name and a price column. You will match the columns and see every row before anything is saved.
importer.tillcalcBody: A TillCalc price-change file brings in approved selling prices only — never costs.
importer.safetyNote: Formulas are never run and files over 10 MB are refused. Nothing is saved until you tap Import.
importer.needNameAndPrice: Choose a column for the product name and one for the price.
importer.ambiguous: {{count}} price(s) like "1,234" could be read two ways. Check the format before continuing.
importer.currencyNote: Prices are read as {{currency}} (your shop currency).

statusHelp.new: No new products in this file.
statusHelp.unchanged: No rows match your products exactly.

reason.badPrice: Row {{row}}: price not readable in this format
reason.fieldTooLong: Row {{row}}: a value is too long to store
reason.duplicateInFile: Row {{row}}: the same product appears more than once in the file
reason.barcodeBelongsToOther: Row {{row}}: the barcode belongs to another product

importer.queueOnImport: Add changed labels to To print
importer.queueOnImportHint: New products and changed prices get a label waiting
importer.skipNote: Same, conflict and invalid rows are skipped. Fix them in the file and import again.
importer.alreadyImported: This exact file was imported before. Rows that did not change will show as Same.

errors.tooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB. Split it into smaller files.
errors.read: The file could not be read. Save it as CSV (UTF-8) or .xlsx and try again.
errors.currencyMismatch: This file is in {{file}} but your shop currency is {{shop}}. Nothing was imported.
errors.commit: The import could not be saved. Nothing was changed.
errors.changedSincePreview: Your products changed since the preview. Nothing was imported — preview again.
errors.overLimit: The Free plan keeps up to {{limit}} products; this file would add more than the {{count}} still free. Nothing was imported. Your existing products are never locked.
errors.nothingToImport: Nothing new or changed to import.

xlsx.tooLarge: The spreadsheet is too large to read safely.
xlsx.noSheet: The spreadsheet has no readable sheet.
xlsx.tooManyRows: More than 20,000 rows. Split the file.
xlsx.tooManyColumns: More than 60 columns. Remove the ones you do not need.

priceChange.notJson: This is not a TillCalc price-change file.
priceChange.wrongFormat: This is not a TillCalc price-change file.
priceChange.unsupportedVersion: This file is from a newer TillCalc. Update TillLabel and try again.
priceChange.badCurrency: The file has no valid currency.
priceChange.tooManyItems: The file has too many products (over 20,000).
priceChange.badItem: A product in the file is incomplete. Nothing was imported.
priceChange.checksumMismatch: The file was changed or damaged after TillCalc created it. Nothing was imported.
priceChange.containsCosts: The file contains cost data, which TillLabel never imports. Nothing was imported.

importer.encodingNote: This file is not UTF-8; it was read as a Windows (Excel) file. Check that names and symbols look right in the preview.

offers.title: Offers
offers.subtitle: The normal price is never changed
offers.emptyBody: Create was/now, % off, money off, multibuy or member-price offers and print them as tickets or cards.
offers.name: Offer name (not printed)
offers.datesNote: The end date is printed on the label (“Until …”).
offers.normalKept: Each product keeps its normal price; only the offer labels show the offer.

problem.badPromotion: offer is not cheaper than the normal price

offers.saveAndQueue: Save and add labels to To print
offers.queuedBody: {{count}} offer label(s) are waiting in To print. Choose a ticket or card format there.

errors.conditionRequired: Write the condition, e.g. With loyalty card.
errors.badDates: The end date is before the start date.
errors.mixedCurrency: All products in one offer must use the same currency.
errors.saveFailed: The offer could not be saved. Nothing was changed.

reduce.title: Reduced to clear
reduce.subtitle: The normal price is never changed
reduce.chooseOrType: Choose a product, or just type below
reduce.mustBeLower: The reduced price must be below the normal price.
reduce.normalKept: The product keeps its normal price. Reduced labels are printed from To print.
reduce.addedBody: {{count}} label(s) are waiting in To print.
reduce.failed: The reduction could not be saved. Nothing was changed.
